fusions.name: Ridden Down
fusions.desc: Rushes you to a target up to 8 tiles away, then deals 13 damage and leaves it 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds. You move 15% faster for 4 seconds after using it.

fusions.name: Rallying Cast
fusions.desc: Throws a strand that deals 30 damage to the first enemy it meets. When it hits, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Gallop Rope
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 40% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Stride Beat
fusions.desc: Every 6 tiles you cover, you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
